name: Intercontinental Paris - Avenue Marceau
positioning: An InterContinental hotel in Paris's 8th arrondissement close to the Champs-Elysées and the Arc de Triomphe, officially named InterContinental Paris - Champs-Elysées Etoile, with rooms and suites designed by Alexandre Danan
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Champs-Elysées and the Arc de Triomphe
Couples planning a celebration or proposal in Paris

facts.text: The hotel is in the 8th arrondissement, in the heart of the shopping on the Champs-Elysées.
The Avenue des Champs-Élysées is a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
The Fondation Pierre Bergé - Yves Saint Laurent is a few steps from the hotel.
The nearest metro stations are George V and Charles de Gaulle Etoile.
Every room has a Dyson hairdryer.
Rooms have a custom-designed Nespresso machine.
The Junior Suite may include a balcony, a landmark view and a top-floor location.
Classic and Premium Rooms may include a balcony and a city view.
Breakfast at Monsieur Marceau is served indoors or on the terrace, with buffet and a la carte options.
The hotel has a fitness center.
The hotel is a single-use plastic free hotel.

highlights.text: The rooms feature Venetian frescoes on the ceiling.
The rooms and suites were designed by Alexandre Danan.
The hotel is located close to the Champs-Elysées and the Arc de Triomphe.
Golden Keys concierges provide tailored tips and can create a guest's itinerary, including restaurant reservations and show and exhibit tickets.
The hotel offers Incredible Occasions, bespoke celebrations crafted in-room or in exclusive settings, such as birthday surprises, proposals and anniversaries.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
The hotel has one on-site restaurant.
WhataHotel notes a busy central location with an urban atmosphere.
